description: This Java class 'AndroidLogcatFormatter' provides methods to format and parse log messages for Android logcat, including handling message headers, log levels, and message content with a custom separator.

classes.name: AndroidLogcatFormatter
classes.description: A utility class for formatting and parsing Android logcat messages with custom headers and separators.

methods.name: formatMessage
methods.description: Formats a log message with header information into a string suitable for logcat output.

methods.name: parseMessage
methods.description: Parses a formatted log message string back into a header object and message content.
